research_scope: Fresh-cohort indication ablation, shuffled-image control, and non-oracle multimodal QA

encoder.view_policy: Normalize each view, average views per case, then normalize

reranking.score_normalization: Independent min-max normalization within the text shortlist
reranking.tie_break: Descending fused score then ascending case_id

random_image_control.assignment: A deterministic random derangement of source-case image embeddings; no source keeps its own image

statistics.primary_qa_comparison: multimodal verified Token-F1 minus report-only verified Token-F1

claim_limits: This experiment was specified locally before execution but was not formally preregistered or externally timestamped before outcomes were observed.
The confirmation cohort is fresh and disjoint from prior project cohorts but comes from the same OpenI/IU-Xray source, so it is not external validation.
The fresh benchmark is still closed-set paired-report retrieval, not new-patient diagnosis.
The questions are report-derived and are not radiologist-authored clinical questions.
Automatic answer metrics and semantic verification are not a substitute for independent clinical rating.
